# Accessibility Requirements Checklist: 001 Platform Foundation

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and verifiability of keyboard-accessibility requirements for the neutral frontend shell and shared states.
**Created**: 2026-09-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are keyboard-operability and visible-focus requirements stated for the neutral shell and its interactive controls? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK002 Are keyboard-accessibility expectations represented for the shared loading, empty, error, not-found, and unexpected-failure states? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, §SC-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK003 Is “keyboard-operable” clear enough to distinguish usable controls and navigation from controls requiring a pointer? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK004 Is “visibly indicated” focus clear enough to distinguish a perceivable focus state from focus that is merely technically present? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Consistency and Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] CHK005 Are the keyboard and visible-focus requirements consistent between FR-012, SC-006, the frontend state contract, and the documented accessibility review? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §SC-006; Plan §Local Development, CI and Verification]
- [ ] CHK006 Can the requirement for keyboard-operable controls and visible focus be objectively assessed without adding accessibility criteria the user has explicitly excluded from this checklist? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012, §SC-006; User clarification]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- This checklist is limited to keyboard access and visible focus; broader accessibility criteria were excluded by user selection.
